title: Example 126: a backoff's doubling loop replaced by a shift, refuted on the record's components
description: Regression proof (B9, Crosscut, JBMC) of net.terminalvalue.crosscut.retry.Backoff#delayMillis, a method of a record whose two components are the symbolic receiver, unwound 32 times. Expected: a violation, the shift leaving the range of a long; the library's inline run found delayMillis(this=Backoff[baseMillis=1, capMillis=1], attempt=-1) in 1.9 s.
capabilities: regression proof of a record's method
